paired_comparison.reason: One valid draft only; no paired candidate judgments.

safe_aggregate.interpretation: Independent partial is a non-pass category, not a partial agreement score. These are fixed-label comparisons, not a new evaluation.

failure_themes.description: A compound claim adds or changes a purpose, causal link, or other material relationship that its source does not establish.
failure_themes.basis: Existing locked full-source and selected-evidence reasons; no new semantic labels.

failure_themes.description: A claim changes an action's progress/commitment status, prospective versus completed state, or bounded time period.
failure_themes.basis: Existing locked reasons about status and temporal scope; not a new count of source requirements.

failure_themes.description: At least one asserted component lies outside the actually selected spans, even though related information exists elsewhere in the full source.
failure_themes.basis: A narrower subtype of incomplete selected-evidence support. The five selected-evidence failures also include material relationship/status errors in otherwise relevant exact citations.

overlap_accounting.note: Broad support-axis failures are outcomes, not additional theme counts. Draft-level coverage/readability counts and citation-span counts must not be added to claim counts.

limitations.model_emitted_one_support_label_per_clai: The same original model label is compared separately to the two locked independent support axes; no claim is made that the model separately assessed both axes.
